name: cg_exchanges_list
description:
Spot cryptocurrency exchanges from CoinGecko (exchanges), ranked by trust score.
Returns {exchanges: [{id, name, year_established, country, url, trust_score, trust_score_rank, trade_volume_24h_btc, ...}]}.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, exchanges per page; default 20; CoinGecko allows up to 250).
For one exchange's details use cg_exchange_info (with the id from here); derivatives venues are in cg_derivatives_exchanges.
Example: {"limit": 10}

limit.description: Number of exchanges (CoinGecko allows up to 250)
